[{"insert":"1 1/4 Dumbbell Bench Press

The 1 1/4 dumbbell bench press adds a quarter rep at the bottom of each press, so you lower all the way, come up a quarter, back down, then press up fully. That extra quarter doubles the time your chest spends in the hardest, most stretched position. The weight will feel light on its own, but the flys that follow make sure your chest still gets a strong burn. Keep both moves close to failure.
"}]
